                                   GALWAY COUNTY COUNCIL
                          PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT ACTS 2000 - 2010

                   NOTIFICATION of decision to REFUSE extension of the
     appropriate period as defined in S. 42 of the Planning and Development Act 2000 (as
                                           amended)

                           Reference Number:                             24/155

                           Date of Receipt of Application:               06/06/2024

        [ADDRESSEE REDACTED]

EXTENSION OF DURATION for the construction of a single storey office building (total floor
area circa 184sqm) with landscaping, boundary treatments and associated site works
at site adjacent to Old Church / library, Main Street, Oranmore. Gross floor space of
proposed works: 184 sqm

I hereby give you NOTICE that Galway County Council has by order dated 25th July 2024 has made a decision to
REFUSE EXTENSION OF DURATION of the 'Appropriate Period' of a previous grant of planning permission under
planning reference number 19/561.

For the reason(s) set out hereunder;
Having regard to the introduction of Section 28(1) of the Planning and Development (Housing) and
Residential Tenancies Act 2016 (No. 17 of 2016) (as amended by subsection (1) of Section 57 of the Planning
and Development (Amendment) Act 2018 (No. 16 of 2018), the mechanism for securing an extension of
duration for planning permission for those developments which have not yet commenced or not had
substantial works completed has been omitted and can no longer be availed subsequent to the 9 th September
2021.
Therefore, the Planning Authority must refuse the application for an Extension of Duration for the
development permitted under PL. Ref. 19/561 in accordance with Section 28(1) of the Planning and
Development (Housing) and Residential Tenancies Act 2016 (No. 17 of 2016) (as amended by subsection
(1) of Section 57 of the Planning and Development (Amendment) Act 2018 (No. 16 of 2018).
Section 28(1) of the 2016 Act, as amended, amends section 42 of the Planning and Development Act 2000 to
delete section 42 (1)(a)(ii), which allows for applications for extensions of the appropriate period of a
planning permission where commercial, economic or technical considerations beyond the applicant’s control
substantially militated against either commencement or substantial works in respect of the development.
Therefore, there is no legislative provision to facilitate the extension of duration of the appropriate period
sought.
It is recommended that the extension of duration is not permitted as the development does not comply with
Section 42(1)(a)(i) of the Planning and Development Act 2000 (as amended).

            ______ DAY OF JULY 2024
